column1: # The snapshot corpus index: one row per case, and the single source of truth
# for what this corpus records. See README.md before changing a row.
# `verdict` and `rule` were derived by compiling every case under `cases/`
# through the ordinary compiler path on this branch; they describe this
# compiler today and carry no specification authority.
# The gate compares `verdict` (accept|reject) and nothing else. `rule` is
# reference only and is never checked, because which numbered rule a rejection
# cites is a diagnostic choice this corpus deliberately does not pin.

column7: doc
